subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact because keeping one case with one resource should reduce handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 hurt: attributable throughput worsened by 1466.054 h/case with z=371.67, with waiting also worse.
evidence: Confirmation run without NI-004 measured replace waiting +1624.825 h/case, z=443.25
contradictions.note: The expected handover benefit was overwhelmed by queue and contention effects in this configuration.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong positive time impact because fewer hands should remove coordination and waiting.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 hurt: its sole-owned intake waiting and duration worsened, and attributable throughput rose by 42.2906 h/case with z=41.06.
evidence: NI-001 sole-owned intake waiting and duration both worsened
contradictions.note: The strong positive time direction is not reliable for this observed stretch; NI-004's counterfactual benefit does not remove the NI-001 contradiction.

subject: Case-based Work
Extra Resources
contradictions.prior_said: These heuristics have a WEAK_CONFLICT because both alter timing on a shared activity and their effects are difficult to separate.
contradictions.measured_said: Repair improved while diagnosis 1st waiting increased, and repair effects were shared across the applied candidates.
evidence: Displacement conflict at repair: waiting fell by 90.171 h/case, z=-17.65
Repair effects were shared among CBW-001, XR-001, and other applied candidates
contradictions.note: The measured displacement is consistent with the weak-conflict prior, though it does not isolate this pair.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has weak positive time and quality impacts.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 significantly worsened attributable throughput and waiting rather than improving time.
evidence: Attributable throughput worsened by 1466.054 h/case with z=371.67
CA-001 was not built in Phase-3, so this is an attributed measurement rather than a Phase-3 build result
contradictions.note: The time direction is contradicted; the quality component was not directly measured here.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong positive time impact because fewer participants reduce coordination and waiting.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 worsened intake waiting, service duration, and attributable throughput despite being built.
evidence: NI-001 attributable throughput worsened by 12.5453 h/case with z=261.57
contradictions.note: The strong positive time claim is directly contradicted by the built candidate's attributed results.
